candidates.title: Decide the uninstall evidence scope
criteria: Accept the observed app-closed GitHub continuity and fresh-host reconstruction as RFC0022 AC10 evidence, while recording actual desktop uninstall as unobserved.
candidates.content:
# Proposed owner amendment: uninstall evidence for RFC-0022

Pending decision. Mandate r3 remains in force until explicitly amended.
Candidate source `0f3188093c846cbbb43f624dd48c817e0ea4eec4`; signed capsule
image `522e446ad4d34f233daccf45dfcd949654344c9293871305ed83f905444ebd42`.

AC-10 currently requires: “A GitHub-only collaborator can see the linked code,
read the complete prose, reply through ordinary GitHub UI, and retain that
conversation after BetterPullReview is uninstalled.”

The accepted GitHub-only course proved code, prose, attribution and ordinary
reply continuity with BetterPullReview closed and its temporary capsule detached.
Public GET found root4116623474 and reply4116804415 under the same parent, file
and immutable head. The unchanged signed app subsequently displayed that reply
at Markdown line62. All six journal digests and both remote records stayed
unchanged; no Publish or Retry occurred. Fresh-host fixtures independently
reconstruct the canonical anchor and prose without a local database or receipt.

No installed desktop application was uninstalled and no user profile was erased.
The native install/remove matrix remains outside this evidence under RFC-0038.

Accept changes only RFC-0022's required evidence for the last clause of AC-10:
the observed GitHub-only course with the app closed/capsule detached, plus the
existing fresh-host/no-database reconstruction fixtures, suffice for RFC-0022
closeout. The product invariant that uninstall preserves GitHub content remains.
The ledger must continue to say actual desktop uninstall is unobserved; this
decision supplies no installation, purge, credential-removal or release approval.

Reject retains the literal uninstall evidence requirement. Record a requested
change in the note. Independent-review disposition is a separate decision.

Evidence: `m4-final-continuity.json`, `m4-r3-get-recovery-success.json`,
`m3-evidence.json`, and the fifteen-row RFC-0022 verification ledger.

candidates.title: Decide the independent-review requirement
criteria: Explicitly waive the separate independent-review requirement for the exact verified RFC0022 candidate and substitute owner acceptance; no independent report is claimed.
candidates.content:
# Proposed owner amendment: independent acceptance for RFC-0022

Pending decision. Mandate r3's separately required independent acceptance remains
open. No independent reviewer report has been supplied. The selected execution
recipe forbids extra reviewer agents; the implementing engineer's self-review
and passing tests cannot satisfy independence.

Accept explicitly waives the separate independent-review acceptance requirement
for RFC-0022 at production source
`0f3188093c846cbbb43f624dd48c817e0ea4eec4`, and substitutes the owner's acceptance
of the disclosed engineering evidence below. This is an owner amendment, never
an independent technical report. It does not waive any other pending criterion,
the uninstall decision, a known critical defect, or final documentation gates.

The implemented path uses one ordinary source-line comment gesture and publication
lane. Its durable journal admits fallback only after exact unsupported evidence;
ambiguous historical native attempts stay GET-only. The owner-approved classifier2
is restricted to PR2's exact base/head, actor/profile2 and revalidated source/patch
facts. It accepts a bounded message dependency whose interpretation risk remains;
this supplies no general GitHub or GHES capability guarantee.

Evidence includes native/file wire and refusal fixtures; 66 deterministic
interruption/restart courses; canonical permalink and fresh-host reconstruction;
three-scale/three-theme Qt evidence; production public composition; strict tidy
and format; and configured mutation-isolation gates. D's actual signed app created
one FILE root4116623474, then exposed receipt/read placeholder mismatches. Narrow
fixes24b7f66aa/0f3188093 retain honest FILE subjects and remove synthetic line1
before semantic reconstruction. Signed GET-only reopening recovered the existing
receipt without a second Publish. The human accepted ordinary GitHub continuity;
a final signed read displayed reply4116804415 under that root at line62. All six
journal digests and both remote records remained unchanged.

The final focused read/paged/permalink/public-composition checks pass. No native
off-hunk success, live GHES, Windows qualification, actual installed-app uninstall,
OS-kill/power-loss matrix, package trust or complete release qualification is
claimed. Relevant earlier evidence is reused only where its source is unchanged.

Reject retains the independent-review requirement; it needs a separately authorized
review course under a reconciled execution plan. Record a requested change in the
note. No code is approved for another repository or target by this decision.

Evidence: `m1-evidence.json`, `m2-evidence.json`, `m3-evidence.json`,
`m4-r3-classifier-evidence.json`, `m4-r3-schema-integration.md`,
`m4-r3-file-receipt-fix.json`, `m4-r3-file-read-fix.json`,
`m4-final-continuity.json`, and the fifteen-row RFC-0022 verification ledger.
